follow-up time: From before pregnancy until after pregnancy
outcome: EQ-5D domains (mobility, pain/discomfort, anxiety/depression, self-care, usual activities)
cohort: 86 women with congenital heart disease who gave birth in Skåne County between 2009 and 2021
finding: Women with CHD experience worse mobility and higher pain levels during the third trimester of pregnancy compared to before pregnancy, but their overall health-related quality of life remains acceptably high.
mod_finding: Women who had a Caesarean section had significantly higher anxiety/depression scores before pregnancy compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
